last.verdict: Beyond Meat's margins and cash burn improved, but revenue is still shrinking and the fourth-quarter outlook points to a sharper drop.

takeaways.label: Sales slide continues
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million, at the high end of guidance. Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $54-59 million, below this quarter's level.

takeaways.label: U.S. keeps shrinking
takeaways.text: U.S. retail sales fell 13.2% and U.S. foodservice 9.7% on lost shelf space and weak category demand. Europe-led international retail grew 13.3%, a third straight quarter of growth.

takeaways.label: Margins and burn improving
takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 19.3% (7.4% a year ago), the best in five years. Cash used in operations over nine months was $37.3 million versus $101.2 million.

takeaways.label: Heavy debt, ongoing dilution
takeaways.text: Cash is $169.3 million against $313.9 million of debt. Another $15 million of 2027 notes was swapped into shares, leaving $14.5 million due March 2027.

history.verdict: Revenue beat, but a weak Q3 outlook and wider core losses sent shares down.

reasons.label: Weak Q3 outlook
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $60-65 million, below Wall Street's roughly $65.6 million estimate.

reasons.label: Wider core loss
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $27.7 million from $24.7 million a year ago.

reasons.label: Falling U.S. sales
reasons.text: U.S. revenue fell 14.4% on weak category demand and fewer stores carrying products.
